name: adamantine
unidentified_descriptor: a midnight-dark blade that shows no edge wear
first_pickup_chronicle: Adamantine. The metal does not bend, does not chip, does not forgive. Every legendary smith dreams about this metal and dies without ever working a forge hot enough.
design_notes: Peak F65 spread 14. damage_mult 1.40 — top-tier raw damage. weight_mult 1.40 — HEAVY. max_enchant 5. The 'tank' material — unbreakable, immune to rust monsters / acid attacks (HUGE — rust monsters are a roguelike classic terror). Adamantine plate at 65 × 1.4 = 91 lb is brutal for low-STR; this is fighter-class gear. armor_ac_bonus 2 — best in class. cite: curve F60 weapon_base_damage=8; adamantine longsword = 8 × 1.40 = ~11 base × 6× chain = 66 damage vs Fafnir HP 421 = ~6 hit kill at chain 5 — viable Fafnir clear with quest layer.
